$comment: Byte-identical to firebase.json except that every emulator binds 0.0.0.0. Inside a container 127.0.0.1 means 'reachable only from this container', so the published ports would answer nothing and the stack would look started while being unusable. scripts/check-ports.mjs asserts this file agrees with firebase.json on every port, names the same database, and uses 0.0.0.0 throughout.
